nightReady.en: It is nighttime. The encounter has a 20% chance; a quiet visit does not mean the story is broken.
nightReady.zh-CN: 当前属于夜间。相遇仍有20%概率；这次没发生新事件不代表剧情出错。

nightWaiting.en: Return at night, from 9 p.m. through 7 a.m. Travel and conversations advance time; opening menus does not.
nightWaiting.zh-CN: 请在夜间21点至次日7点之间再来。旅行与交谈会推进时间，打开菜单不会。

any: 白马啸西风_陈达海加入2

detail.en: Don Quixote joined; Dulcinea stayed with the villagers. Gines used his rescue story to cover a theft. The invitation costs 2 Morality. Select the knight in Companions, equip gear, and choose a learning guide and an equipped mastery separately. Team Practice uses only the first two slots; move him to slot two to earn study XP.
detail.zh-CN: 堂吉诃德加入了，杜尔西内娅留下帮助村民。希内斯利用他的救人故事掩盖盗窃，邀请扣2点道德。到伙伴页选择骑士，穿装备，分别设置研习教材和主专精。结伴练习只让前两位出场，培养他时请调到第二位。

any: 白马啸西风_陈达海加入3

title.en: The knight follows his own trail

detail.en: You left Don Quixote to help repair the damage at camp. That ends this invitation. Keep the recovered copy of Amadis of Gaul for related quests, prepare your companions, and explore another story.
detail.zh-CN: 你让堂吉诃德留下弥补营地的损失，这次邀请已经结束。请保留追回的《阿马迪斯》用于相关任务，整备伙伴后再探索其他故事。

title.en: Put your new magic to work

detail.en: The supplies are going home, and Dulcinea is traveling with you. She earned 30 attribute points, +40 spell aptitude, and +500 maximum Health and Energy. In Gear & study, choose Dulcinea under Party member, then select the Bloodthorn Bolt Tome. Her equipped mastery is separate. Move her to slot 2 in Party for Team Practice. Her spells burst along her row and column: choose the spell, then her own tile.
detail.zh-CN: 补给已送回，杜尔西内娅选择与你同行。她获得30培养点、法术熟练+40、生命和能量上限各+500。在“装备与研习”的“当前队员”中选择她，再选血棘飞矢法术书；主专精另行设置。结伴练习前，可在队伍把她调到第二位。她的法术沿自身同行与同列爆发：先选招，再点她自己的格子。

detail.en: You recovered a copy of Amadis of Gaul. Look inside Windmill Storehouse for Don Quixote: his event still has a 20% chance, so leave and return if he is absent. Inviting him costs 2 Morality. This is the other recruitment ending; helping Dulcinea earlier did not guarantee the 60 trust she needs.
detail.zh-CN: 你追回了一册《阿马迪斯·德·高拉》。在风车粮仓内找堂吉诃德，事件仍有20%概率，没出现时可离开后再来。邀请扣2点道德。这是另一种招募结局；此前帮助女主，也不保证信任已达到60。

detail.en: Dulcinea's trust was below 60, so she traveled with the villagers instead. This is a different story branch, not a broken recruit button or a judgment that you are evil. Windmill Storehouse has two fights: stop Gines, then resolve a confused confrontation in the smoke with Dulcinea and the camp defenders. The entrance still has a 50% chance. Save and prepare your current party first.
detail.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅信任不足60，因此和村民一起行动。这是另一条剧情分支，不是招募失效，也不是判玩家为恶人。风车粮仓有两战：阻止希内斯，再解决烟雾中与女主、营地卫士的误会。入口仍有50%概率。先保存，并整备现有队伍。

any: 白马啸西风_李文秀加入

title.en: Follow the wagons to Windmill Storehouse

detail.en: Dulcinea trusts you enough to investigate together. Equip her and follow the wagons to Windmill Storehouse. If no scene starts after you enter, use Back to return to the road and try the entrance again. The event has a 50% chance. This branch recruits her; Don Quixote's invitation belongs to the other ending. Save before the fight.
detail.zh-CN: 杜尔西内娅愿意和你一同追查。为她穿好装备，沿车辙前往风车粮仓。若进入后没有剧情，点返回回到道路，再次进入；事件概率为50%。这条路线招募女主，骑士的邀请属于另一结局。交战前保存。

any: 白马啸西风_李文秀出走

detail.en: A knight has mistaken the camp for a giant's prison. The confrontation still has a 30% chance when you visit. Helping Dulcinea adds 5 trust; backing the knight subtracts 5 and costs 3 Morality. Recruitment needs 60 trust. Your choice matters, but it is not a direct recruit-one-or-the-other menu.
detail.zh-CN: 骑士把营地误认成了巨人的牢笼，造访时仍有30%概率发生冲突。帮助女主加5信任；支持骑士减5信任，并扣3点道德。招募女主须达到60信任，因此站哪边会有影响，但不是一个直接选收谁的菜单。

title.zh-CN: 入夜后再找杜尔西内娅

detail.en: Save on the map before checking her night patrol. Quiet visits repeat the everyday reply and add no trust. Follow her, then choose Return the supplies first for +5 trust. The optional field test costs 5 trust. Losing either the patrol fight or that test ends the journey. The patrol uses only you and Dulcinea; other companions will not gain study XP.
detail.zh-CN: 夜间找她前，先在地图上保存。普通造访会重复日常回答，不加信任。跟随后选择先送回补给，可加5信任；可选实地考核会扣5信任。夜巡战或该考核失败都会结束旅程。夜巡只有你与杜尔西内娅出场，其他伙伴不会获得研习经验。

title.zh-CN: 去风骑营地认识杜尔西内娅

detail.en: Meet Dulcinea at Windrider Camp. Supply wagons are disappearing, and someone is selling travelers a story about a giant. Talk to her first. Recruiting her later requires 60 trust; otherwise the story follows the knight's alternative invitation.
detail.zh-CN: 先到风骑营地认识杜尔西内娅。补给马车不断失踪，还有人向旅人兜售巨人的故事。先与她交谈；之后招募她须达到60信任，否则会转入骑士的另一份邀请。

completeText.en: Your party is ready to explore. Meet Dulcinea at Windrider Camp and follow the missing wagons to Windmill Storehouse. Trust, nighttime encounters and your choices affect recruitment. Save before a major decision.
completeText.zh-CN: 队伍已准备好。去风骑营地认识杜尔西内娅，沿失踪马车的线索前往风车粮仓。信任、夜间相遇和选择会影响招募，重要决定前记得保存。

schoolNote.en: Choose a training organization, or travel independently. Round Table has a guided first training route and a companion at graduation. Its mountain pass stays closed until then. Joining starts that route immediately; signature techniques are earned later.
schoolNote.zh-CN: 可以加入组织训练，也可以独自旅行。圆桌骑士团有完整的初步训练指引，出师时会有伙伴加入；此前山道不会开放。点击加入即开始该路线，特色技艺仍需后续获取。

detail.en: Speak with Grimm. His first gift is a mastery scroll, not a demand for rent.
detail.zh-CN: 和格林交谈，领取第一份专精卷轴。他暂时不会收你房租。

detail.en: Open your adventurer's journal and equip a weapon from your bag. Your first practice blade is ready to use. Crossroads Supplies sells armor when you need it.
detail.zh-CN: 打开冒险者手册，把行囊中的武器穿上。第一把练习武器已经备好，需要护甲时可去十字镇补给铺。

detail.en: Steadfast Mastery is your first passive. Keep it equipped, then select its manual in Study. Fighting earns study XP. If the manual is already completed, continue with your learned skills or find a new guide.
detail.zh-CN: 坚毅专精是你的第一项被动专精，保持装备，再在研习区选择对应手册。实战会给予研习经验；本书已掌握时可继续使用本领，或寻找新教材。

detail.en: Ask the village instructor to practice. You can use a Welcome Elixir from Inventory first. Win the practice fight to complete this goal. If you lose, get ready and try again.
detail.zh-CN: 找村中教官练习。可先在行囊使用一份启程药剂。赢得练习战斗才能完成此目标；落败后可准备好再试。

detail.en: Ask Grimm about leaving, then accept his practical lessons. Prepare before setting out: the instructor stays in the village.
detail.zh-CN: 向格林询问出发的事，并接受实地教学。出发前先做好准备，教官会留在村中。

detail.en: Visit Crossroads Supplies. Choose one free learning guide, receive five tonics, then make an actual purchase. Bring the supplies back to Grimm.
detail.zh-CN: 前往十字镇补给铺，选择一份赠送教材、领取五份药剂，再实际购买一件商品。随后回去向格林交差。

detail.en: Meet Eir in Healer's Vale and offer to travel together. Her missing-stoat expedition continues later; joining the party is enough for this field assignment.
detail.zh-CN: 去药师谷见埃尔，答应结伴同行。寻宠的后续探险留到以后，本章先完成招募。

detail.en: Return to Grimm's home and choose Team Practice. Both companions must take part. This goal needs a real victory; if defeated, prepare and try again.
detail.zh-CN: 回格林居所，选择结伴练习，让两位队员一起参战。这个目标需要实际获胜，落败后可准备好再挑战。

detail.en: Save on the map. Return to the title and Continue Journey to check that your companion, equipment and scroll study remain.
detail.zh-CN: 在地图上保存。回到标题后继续旅程，检查伙伴、装备和卷轴研习是否保留。

description.en: A swift attack with a sharp beak.
description.zh-CN: 用尖喙迅速攻击。

description.en: Measured sword strokes. Check the skill panel for power, cost and reach.
description.zh-CN: 节奏分明的剑术。威力、消耗和距离见技能面板。

description.en: A gauntlet technique. Power, range, cost and unlocked effects are listed in the skill panel.
description.zh-CN: 拳套战技。实际威力、距离、消耗及解锁效果见技能面板。

description.en: Practical heavy weapon skills for an unwelcoming road.
description.zh-CN: 适合在险路上开道的实用重武器。

description.en: Swordplay built around changes of angle. See the skill panel for its actual effect.
description.zh-CN: 围绕角度变化展开的剑术，实际效果见技能面板。

description.en: Open-country heavy weapon skills with a traveler's sense of economy.
description.zh-CN: 草原旅人讲求实用的弯刀技艺。

description.zh-CN: 来自山间学派的拳套战技。威力、消耗和距离见技能面板。

description.en: A woven pattern of gauntlet strikes. Check the panel for range and cost.
description.zh-CN: 以交织手法施展的拳套攻击，距离和消耗见面板。

description.en: Patient swordplay taught above the mountain roads.
description.zh-CN: 在山道之上修习的沉稳剑术。
